title: Stropha
extract:
The Stropha is a  Corpus Gunblade used by Stropha Crewmen with high damage, critical chance, and critical multiplier that shoots a single, wide but close-ranged shockwave.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage on its melee attacks, and  Impact damage on its gunblade shots.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Bullet Dance and  High Noon stance.
Gunblade shots shoot a single shockwave.
High  Impact damage. Can benefit from  Shattering Impact.
Shots have a wide radius.
Firing within 1 meter of an enemy will  Ragdoll them.
Shots do not use ammo.
Shots have innate Infinite Body Punch Through.
Immediate damage falloff from 100% to 50% after 11m target distance and from 50% to 10 base damage from 15m to 17m target distance (distances are affected by Projectile Speed, for melee weapons only via  Jet Stream).
Limited range of 17 meters.
Alarming.
No bonus damage on headshots.
Can still perform headshots to bypass Corpus Shield Gating for example, but does not receive any bonus damage.

Acquisition
The Stropha's main blueprint is a possible reward from defeating the Jackal. Component blueprints can be acquired from within the Granum Void; the Barrel and Blade from Rotation C, the Receiver from Rotation C of Exemplar Granum Void, and the Stock from Rotation C of the Zenith Granum Void. All components can be traded between players, but not the main blueprint.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

This weapon can be sold for  7,500.

Trivia
Stropha is Latin for Greek strophè (στροφή) which means a turn, bend or twist, probably refers to its function as a gunblade.
Text on the end of the barrel section translates to "GUN BLADE" in Corpus.

Bugs
In-game, the Heavy Attack damage displayed is 1,100, the actual value is 2,800 however.
The displayed Heavy Attack damage is a 5x multiplier of the Stropha's 220 base damage, the actual value is only a 4x multiplier from the Stropha's shot damage of 700.
Cannot activate  Melee Crescendo on Finishers that use a projectile to kill.
